name: Mozentum
detailed_description:
BIG FAT PREFACE

Hello you!

It’s early days for Mozentum.

Until this preface is removed, please know: you’re buying an unfinished experience… but one that I’ll be working on with every ounce of spare time I have.

For the foreseeable future, I’m committing to:

  • Delivering a profound, expressive movement adventure with fortnightly (sometimes weekly… even daily) updates.

  • Providing full support — responding quickly and patching issues as soon as I can.

  • Making this thing as damn good as it was destined to be.

If you’ve purchased Mozentum this early — thank you. You’re helping me live my dream.

And yes… there will be hidden prizes for early players.
(More info coming soon on my YouTube channel @stillzen-dev)

GAME DESCRIPTION

[GIF of fast, fluid swinging]
I want to spark that childlike sense of play and exploration in you.
Nothing more.
Nothing less.

Movement — But Really Good

I’ve built a movement system with:

  • Procedural grabbing

  • Swinging

  • Mouse-based pulling power

The skill ceiling is ridiculously high — from mo(z)entum-based vaulting and unique sliding to diving, wallrunning, and more.

[GIF of vaulting into a slide]

Soon, you’ll be able to tweak power values and expand your skill list. If you find yourself addicted to swinging around for no reason, I’ve done my job.

The World

[Image of a wide, strange landscape]
It’s a big, weird world — and you’re oh so small.
Filled with:

  • Strange objects

  • Stranger people

  • …and incense (lots of incense)

Open-mindedness is king, young Jedi.

Expect:

  • Tools & trinkets

  • Beings who love giving unsolicited advice

  • New skills

  • Sick digs (clothes)

  • Maybe even enlightenment

Themes & Vibes

Alchemy.
Spirituality.
Zen.
The importance of huffing incense twice daily.
(Also… Max Derrat, if you’re reading this, I love you.)

Roadmap & Future Plans

Mozentum’s scope will grow over time:

  • More quirky NPCs

  • More interactivity

  • More skills

  • Possible multiplayer

  • Van-life features (build your van, stink it up)

  • Equipment (climbing gear, physics grapples, etc.)

[GIF of multiple movement tricks chained together]

Updated All the Time

This game is my baby. I will update it constantly and give you everything I’ve got.

PLEASE GIVE ME FEEDBACK.

  • I’ll reply directly whenever I can.

  • All feedback is good feedback — just keep it clean, clear, and constructive.

I’ve gone through countless trials, broken builds, and total wipeouts to get Mozentum into your hands. It’s been made on a $900 laptop by a guy living full-time in a van.

So… be ready.

short_description: procedural grabbing, swinging and momentum-based movement mechanics all wrapped in a stinky, hippy-themed adventure aesthetic. what's not to love?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1650
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Above
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 2060 or above
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Subject to change minimum and maximum values cause I don't know much about them yet!

content_descriptors.notes: Game's pretty chill. The worst that'll happen is you'll fight baddies and they'll eventually die, or maybe you'll hear me talk about the subject of sex as a conversational topic.
